name: stage22-daemon-live-evidence-queue
queue_decision: collect live evidence through opt-in helpers only; keep dae run default on Go

queue_rows.blocker: artifact must prove the Go fallback build path remains intact before live daemon candidate smoke
queue_rows.rollback: keep output under /tmp and do not install over the system daemon

queue_rows.blocker: helper covers dry runtime, route-aware target, and overview only; it does not start a live daemon
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-cli --bin dae-cli-optin --quiet -- runtime stage22-smoke
queue_rows.rollback: no production state is mutated by the helper

queue_rows.blocker: requires root/BPF/netns/memlock/kernel gates before active traffic can be trusted
queue_rows.rollback: abort before attaching production interfaces or mutating installed daemon state

queue_rows.blocker: SO_MARK and MPTCP must be observed in the active dial network string, not only in config
queue_rows.rollback: return to Go active datapath if mark or mptcp propagation is incomplete

queue_rows.blocker: must prove live start/ready/stop without changing the dae run default engine
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: start and stop an explicit opt-in Rust candidate daemon with isolated config, pid, progress, and sockets
queue_rows.rollback: kill only the opt-in candidate process and keep Go daemon path available

queue_rows.blocker: current helper evidence does not prove active tproxy dialing under daemon traffic
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: transparent TCP traffic through the Rust candidate path preserves SO_MARK=1234 and mptcp=true into MagicNetwork
queue_rows.rollback: fall back to Go control plane and Go outbound dialer path

queue_rows.blocker: UDP endpoint/task pool behavior and DNS route semantics must survive live daemon traffic
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: UDP flow and transparent DNS UDP/53 smoke preserve endpoint pools, DNS routing, and mark/mptcp propagation
queue_rows.rollback: fall back to Go DNS controller and Go UDP endpoint pool path

queue_rows.blocker: EjectBpf/InjectBpf ownership and same-bind DNS listener rollback are default-path blockers
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: successful reload plus injected new-control-plane failure keeps old BPF object, listener, DNS listener, and DNS cache semantics
queue_rows.rollback: restore old control plane ownership and keep old daemon serving

queue_rows.blocker: WebUI/API compatibility needs live control-plane telemetry, not only dry runtime fields
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: RuntimeOverview before and after control-plane init retains active TCP, UDP sessions, UDP task queues, DNS stats, and traffic samples
queue_rows.rollback: keep daed/WebUI on Go runtime overview until live telemetry matches

queue_rows.blocker: dry helper proves target construction only; live RouteDialTcp path still needs evidence
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: domain request through Engine HTTP transport routes via control plane with dest=0.0.0.0:443 and no system DNS resolution
queue_rows.rollback: keep API/subscription fetch on Go route-aware transport

queue_rows.blocker: helper-only microbenchmarks are not acceptable evidence for default daemon switching
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: matched Go/Rust daemon traffic benchmark records throughput, latency, RSS, reload impact, and CPU for the same corpus
queue_rows.rollback: do not change default path when Rust candidate is slower or incomplete

queue_rows.blocker: product chain must not mask daemon parity gaps
queue_rows.command_or_evidence: dae-wing and daed integration remains out of scope until daemon live evidence queue is complete
queue_rows.rollback: keep daed and dae-wing on the existing Go-backed integration path

required_environment: root permission for tproxy and eBPF smoke
bpffs mounted and writable for loader smoke
netns permission for control-plane datapath smoke
memlock limit sufficient for eBPF objects
kernel features compatible with current daenew eBPF program set
isolated loopback traffic harness and temporary config directory
Go toolchain and Go fallback path available
rollback_controls: do not switch dae run default engine
do not replace control.NewControlPlane default path
do not mutate installed systemd ExecStart
keep Go outbound dependency as production fallback
record every live evidence result before changing any gate state
